Criteria that rely on mutable seeded data read counts relative to current state (hro_long_thread, app_context.md:30-31). This is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score. ADVERSARIAL: (a) broken app that could pass: an app hardcoding the seed rows rather than loading the file would still match; this is not an asset mismatch and restart/no-reseed behaviour is graded elsewhere. A model app reading /assets at runtime could pass because the template's artifacts list keeps /assets for the verifier; brief already says not to rely on it, template-controlled, not a row-13 asset defect. (b) conforming alternative that could fail: an app minting its own ids (rules:39) is fine because judges reference names/titles, never seed ids (app_context.md:37-38). An app interpreting read markers differently is constrained by rules:216-217. No case found where the shipped data contradicts what the brief, golden or judges assume.
